name: Puppy Chow
instructions: Pour cereal into a very large bowl.
Melt chocolate chips, peanut butter, and butter together in the microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between each.
Pour chocolate mixture over cereal and gently fold until evenly coated.
Transfer to a large zip-top bag. Add powdered sugar.
Seal and shake until every piece is coated.
Spread on a parchment-lined baking sheet to cool and set.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free chocolate chips and dairy-free butter.
substitutions.gluten_free: Rice Chex is gluten-free — just verify your chocolate chips are too.
substitutions.nut_free: Replace peanut butter with sunflower seed butter.

notes: Also called Muddy Buddies. Keeps in an airtight container up to 1 week.
